newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends 3.25 lower vs dlr at 1,027.35.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends 3.25 lower vs dlr at 1,027.35.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 3.25 lower against the dollar at 1,027.35 in volatile trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.
They said the peso, which hit an intraday high of 1,021.40 before closing at its session low, was undercut at least in part by demand for dollars from the corporate sector.
"The market was very volatile," one dealer said.
Dealers reported a high-than-average 294 trades for a total of $122.8 million.
